notes.title: Update VB.2 Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hi Lexicon fans![/p][p]After doing some more testing with y'all, we wanted to adjust some puzzles and fix a gamebreaking bug. [/p][p][/p][h3]🐞 [b]Bug Squashing[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Entry Naomi Exit Movement[/b]
Some players experienced an issue where Naomi wouldn't move completely offscreen after her argument in the Entry. This causes a game breaking circumstance, so we patched her movement to guarantee she leaves the scene.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧩 [b]Puzzle Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Puzzle Clarity Enhancements[/b]
In the crypt, we made the clues a bit easier to identify and adjusted the number 2 puzzle as the sun might not exist in Ekkos. We also adjusted the puzzle in the ironworks as younger audiences had a difficult time understanding base 2 and base 10 number systems.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please continue to give us feedback through the Steam forums as it helps us make our game better. Thank you for reading! We couldn't do it without you![/p]

notes.title: Update VB.1 Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]This update brings a few exciting improvements to the Lexicon experience:[/p][p][/p][h3]✨ [b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Steam Achievements Added[/b]
You can now unlock achievements as you explore the world of Lexicon! Whether you're discovering secrets or progressing through the story, your milestones will now be rewarded.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧩 [b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Puzzle Clarity Enhancements[/b]
We've updated several puzzles to make their logic and goals more intuitive, based on player feedback. If you found yourself stuck before, give it another shot![/p][/*][/list][h3]🎨 [b]Visual Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Addressed various minor visual bugs throughout the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing Lexicon and being part of its journey. Your feedback continues to shape this world—we hope you enjoy the updates![/p]
